summary.text: Solomon Adesanya was elected to Georgia House District 43 in 2022 and was sworn in on January 9, 2023.

paragraphs.text: The Georgia House Press Office says he owns two restaurants in Cobb County and that the district includes portions of Cobb County.
He is the House Minority Caucus Treasurer and lives in Marietta.

sources.title: Rep. Solomon Adesanya Sworn in, Receives Committee Assignments for the 2023-2024 Legislative Term
